_doc: Curated demo script for live backend comparison over the HAI AI Index Report 2025 corpus. Queries are grouped into a 'ladder' that shows where each retrieval strategy starts to earn its cost: Tier 1 plain RAG already suffices (graph/agentic = overkill); Tier 2 plain BM25/vector RAG fails but GraphRAG bridges entities/abstract vocabulary; Tier 3 agentic + nav shine via multi-step routing, figure parsing and cross-section verification; Tier 4 adversarial questions that every backend should refuse. All queries are drawn from config/evals/graphrag_eval.json so they are grounded in the ingested data. The webui Chat page renders these as one-click preset buttons (settings.project_root/config/evals/demo_queries.json).

tiers.label: Tier 1 — Plain RAG nails it
tiers.summary: Direct factoid lookups where the answer vocabulary matches the source. A single chunk has it; graph + agentic add latency/cost for no quality gain. Use these to set a baseline.

queries.text: What was total corporate AI investment in 2024?
queries.watch_for: Mini/Lazy answer instantly from one chunk. Note how graph/agentic spend extra tokens for the same answer — overkill.

queries.text: How much did inference cost drop for GPT-3.5-equivalent performance?
queries.watch_for: Expect '280x' over '18 months'. Lexical terms are right in the text, so BM25 retrieval is enough.
Date lives in a release-timeline table. Tabular fact, single hop — plain retrieval handles it.

tiers.label: Tier 2 — Plain RAG fails, GraphRAG wins
tiers.summary: Abstract query vocabulary or entity bridging across separate paragraphs. BM25/vector cannot connect the dots; entity/community-aware GraphRAG can. These are tagged DEMO-FAVORS-GRAPHRAG in the eval suite.

queries.text: What real-world incidents of harm to young people from chatbots are documented in the report?
queries.watch_for: Source says '14-year-old boy', 'Sewell Setzer III', 'died by suicide' — none of the query words appear. Run Mini first (weak/missed), then Lazy/MS (bridges the abstract vocabulary).

queries.text: Which individuals are linked to incidents involving Character.AI, and how?
queries.watch_for: Answer needs TWO cases (Setzer + Crecente) that live in different paragraphs but share the Character.AI entity. Graph edges surface both; BM25 grabs one or neither.

queries.text: How has generative AI been used to impersonate a deceased individual without family consent?
queries.watch_for: 'impersonate' / 'deceased' / 'without consent' are NOT in the source (it says 'murdered ... her image appeared in an AI chatbot ... discovered by her father'). Needs semantic/community bridging.

tiers.label: Tier 3 — Where Agentic & Nav shine
tiers.summary: Multi-step questions: metadata-route to the right document, open it, read a figure or distant section, then verify. Agentic plans+critiques; Nav navigates the actual document instead of pre-chunked text.

queries.text: What is the performance of SuperGLUE?
queries.watch_for: Disambiguation trap: 'glue' can collide with adhesives. Nav opens the doc and reads Figure 2.1.33 (human baseline vs benchmark) instead of grabbing a lexically-similar wrong chunk.

queries.text: Compare U.S. and China private AI investment in 2024 and identify which one led.
queries.watch_for: Two figures to retrieve (US 109.1, China 9.3), then a comparison + verdict. Agentic/Nav do retrieve -> compare -> verify; watch the navigation trace expander.

queries.text: Are the Czech Republic's AI talent indicators (hiring, migration, representation) consistent with its public AI spending?
queries.watch_for: Evidence is scattered across distant sections (talent vs. spending). Nav drills into multiple parts of the document and synthesizes a consistency judgement.

tiers.label: Tier 4 — Adversarial (should refuse)
tiers.summary: Out-of-scope questions with no grounding in the corpus. Every backend should decline rather than hallucinate. Demonstrates guardrails.

queries.text: What was Bitcoin's price in March 2024?
queries.watch_for: No crypto pricing in an AI Index report. Good answer = explicit refusal / 'not in the documents', NOT a guessed number.

queries.text: How tall is the Eiffel Tower?
queries.watch_for: Completely off-corpus. Retrieval scores should stay below the grounded threshold; the agent should decline.
